name: sparks
description: Find, capture and organize notes, projects and subtasks in your Sparks idea notebook. No delete tool.

interface.longDescription: Sparks is an idea notebook. This plugin lets Codex find, read, create and organize your notes, projects and subtasks, mark things done, and pick up notes you send to your agent. It signs in with OAuth and never deletes anything.
defaultPrompt: Which Sparks notes are due this week?
